bucket_collapse_rule: A bucket with fewer than 30 drives merges into the next larger bucket (the largest merges into the next smaller).

definitions.classifier_order: touchdown > safety > field goal made/missed > punt > interception > fumble lost > downs > clock
definitions.clock: End of half and end of game merged: the final offensive possession of a half that ended without any other result.
definitions.drive: Offensive possession grouped by the source drive key with at least one offensive snap (pass, run, kneel, spike, punt or field goal by the team in possession; two-point tries excluded; no_play rows count only with an interception, fumble-lost, touchdown, safety or failed-fourth-down flag).
definitions.half_final: The final offensive possession of each regulation half, keyed by half_seconds_remaining at its first snap.
definitions.interior: Drives that are not the final offensive possession of a regulation half (overtime drives are interior).
definitions.net_yards: Yard line of the first snap minus the end spot: touchdown end = 0, punt/field-goal end = line of scrimmage, otherwise line of scrimmage minus yards gained on the last snap. Penalty yardage is included.
definitions.plays: Scrimmage snaps (pass, run, kneel, spike) on the drive; the punt or field-goal snap is not counted.
definitions.seconds: Source drive time of possession; when blank, plays x the category's mean seconds per play.
definitions.tuple: [plays, net_yards, seconds]; field_goal_attempt adds [kick_distance, made, blocked]

information_boundary: 2012 regular-season play-by-play only; no 2013 or later data; no team or game identifiers.

remap.rule: Opponent-touchdown drives are remapped to the play that caused them; the defence's score is not modelled.

comparison.explanation: nflscrapR has 92 fewer pass, 11 fewer punt and 3 fewer field-goal rows and 64 more no_play rows than nflverse, so some drives lose their terminal offensive play.
nflscrapR is missing 115 extra-point rows (1,122 against 1,237); the same 8 non-good kicks appear in both files.

Two kicks (2012101407 play 4223, 2012110400 play 3608) are BLOCKED in the nflverse descriptions but No Good in the nflscrapR descriptions. The sources disagree and the blocked/missed split is unresolved; made and attempted totals are identical and the kernel does not distinguish blocked from missed.
Same two blocked kicks as fg_blocked.
nflscrapR is missing 6 two-point rows (2 successes).

second_pass.independence: nflverse and nflscrapR both derive from the NFL GSIS feed; they are not fully independent sources. The PFR cross-check (drives 5,360, punts 2,520) is blocked by the proxy and remains unresolved.
second_pass.rules: Any count differing by more than 1%, or any mean net-yards figure differing by more than 0.6 yards, fails the build unless listed with an explanation.
second_pass.source: nflscrapR reg_pbp_2012.csv, identical classifier, drive key 'drive'
